 Mirra Andreeva won 12 of the final 13 games to beat Diana Shnaider 6-2, 6-1 in round-robin play at the WTA Finals. Andreeva won Group 2 with a 3-0 record and next plays American Jessica Pegula in the semifinals. Aryna Sabalenka and Elina Svitolina meet later Friday to decide who will play Linda Noskova in the other semi. Shnaider was a late replacement for Karolina Muchova, who withdrew due to illness. Muchova had already lost her first two matches and couldn't advance. Elena Rybakina also withdrew before the tournament started. This is the first time since 2019 that both singles alternates were competing in the round-robin stage.

 INDIAN WELLS, Calif. (AP) — Mirra Andreeva won 12 of the final 13 games to cruise past Diana Shnaider 6-2, 6-1 and complete her round-robin play at the WTA Finals on Friday.
 Andreeva dropped just 11 games total while winning Group 2 with a 3-0 record and will play Jessica Pegula in Saturday's semifinals. Either Aryna Sabalenka or Elina Svitolina, who meet later, will face Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova in the other semifinal at Indian Wells Tennis Garden.
